rules.title: Guess the Pokémon — Rules
rules.intro: Identify the Pokémon shown in the image. You have a limited number of lives depending on difficulty.
rules.howToPlay1: Choose a difficulty and start a new game.
rules.howToPlay2: Type the Pokémon name (English, case-insensitive) and submit.
rules.howToPlay3: Win by guessing correctly before you run out of lives.
rules.easyRule: Easy — 3 lives. XP on win: 50 + 10 × lives left (up to 80).
rules.mediumRule: Medium — 2 lives. XP on win: 100 + 20 × lives left (up to 140).
rules.scoringNote: Winning grants XP and may level you up (loot boxes on level up). Only one active game per user at a time.
rules.activeGameNote: If you already have an active game, finish it before starting another.

guessShiny.subtitle: Four Pokémon appear in a 2×2 grid — only one is the real shiny. Pick the correct slot in a single attempt.

guessShiny.howToPlay2: One slot shows the true shiny; the others are the normal form or tinted variants.
guessShiny.howToPlay3: One attempt only — correct pick wins 100 XP; a wrong pick ends the run.
guessShiny.pickPrompt: Tap the slot you think is the shiny Pokémon.
guessShiny.activeGameHint: You already have a game in progress in this browser. Use Continue game to pick up where you left off.
